sentences.text: On one occasion, a vehicle/truck containing Areca nuts suspected to be Burmese origin were seized by police.
The driver and handyman of the truck were also arrested.
Thereafter, the custody of the vehicle was given in favour of the present petitioner who claims to be the registered owner of the said vehicle.
The case diary does not have sufficient incriminating materials against the present petitioner.
Therefore, he does not deserve to be detained in custody.
Accordingly, his pre-arrest bail is allowed.
It is hereby directed that in the event of arrest, the petitioner Md. Abdul Haque shall be released on bail of Rs.20,000/- with a surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.
The application for bail stands disposed of.
